title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vigneshwaran blackmails Vennila for money using secrets of the plots he helped her execute against Anbu. Karthi reveals Anbu's renewed love for Kanmani to Sivagami.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma resolves to conceal the truth that Paraman is Rishi's missing brother. Ilamathi fails to convince Paraman that Kalamma raised him only for her selfish motives.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Post-competition, Sudar credits Vetri, who carries her home after a bike fall injures her. Abinaya lashes out over the school delay and offers to host Sarala's kin.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel, Vadivu, and Maari visit Pandian's house to invite them to Kumar's wedding. When Kumar refuses to break it off, a panicked Saravanan agrees to wed Arasi to him.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Vannathi Grows Fond of the Doctor
description: Vannathi enjoys getting to know the doctor as they have a good talk. Meanwhile, Nila grows suspicious as Chozhan avoids her calls and suspects that Pandian is hiding the truth.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Celebrating S. Janaki's legacy, the stage comes alive with emotional performances and a breathtaking medley. Heartfelt memories and tributes make the celebration even more special.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: Rakshan unveils the Heritage theme as teams select Comalis. Ma Ka Pa and Ramar bring non-stop laughs before a tough flour-sieving advantage challenge tests everyone!
